polityNote: Counties of Estonia from the first day a 2017 reform merger moved a county border (21 Oct 2017) to the end of 2019; EST-maakonnad-1991.json covers 20 Aug 1991 – 20 Oct 2017. The county-changing mergers took effect 21–25 Oct 2017 (days from Wikidata and fi.wikipedia, which agree where both state one). Atoms: geoBoundaries EST ADM3 (osm-boundaries 2020, villages and towns; ODbL). Each village was placed in its pre-reform municipality by point sampling against the 2017 municipalities (4,713 villages; 4,706 with ≥ 90% of samples in one municipality, the rest inside one county except Tedreküla), then in its county; the villages of the municipalities that changed county follow the reform lists (Palupera, Puka and Meeksi split by village name). ① check (1 Jan 2019): union areas against the post-reform county areas in et.wikipedia Maakond oldid 7002216 agree within −1.0%…−0.2% for 13 counties; for Põlva and Võru that table still gives the pre-reform figures (equal to the 2011 ones), so it cannot judge the Värska/Mikitamäe/Orava/Meeksi moves.
